formulations.name: Dagamula Niruha Basti (Vatika)
formulations.preparation_method: Decoction of dagamala and meat juice of goat mixed with sour substances, paste of dagamala added with three fats

formulations.name: Laghu Panchamula Basti (Digestive)
formulations.preparation_method: Decoction 640 ml mixed with meat juice 320 ml, heated and reduced to 640 ml, then paste and fats added

formulations.name: Erandabasti
formulations.preparation_method: Boil all herbs in water 5.12 litres reduced to one-fourth. Add paste of satahva, hapusa, priyamgu, madhuka, ela, indrayava, musta along with salt, honey, oil and cow's urine

formulations.name: Goat Meat Basti (Strength and Semen promoting)

ingredients.herb_name: Yavani (etc. as in Baladi Basti verse 13)

formulations.preparation_method: Soup of goat's meat fried in oil and ghee, soured with curd and pomegranates along with paste of yavani as said in baladi basti

formulations.name: Palasa Basti

ingredients.form: decoction in 5.12 litres reduced to one-fourth

formulations.preparation_method: Decoction of palasa in water reduced to one-fourth, added with paste of vaca and magadhika, satahva, rock salt, honey and oil

formulations.name: Madhuyasti Milk Basti (Vatarakta and Voice)
formulations.preparation_method: Milk boiled with madhuyasti, then satahva, madanaphala and pippali paste added along with ghee and honey

formulations.name: Lodhra Madhuyasti Milk Basti (Paittika)
formulations.preparation_method: Milk boiled with madhuyasti, lodhra, usira, candana, lotus and water lily, added with sugar, honey and paste of vitaliser drugs, well-cooled

formulations.name: Chandanadi Milk Basti (All Paittika)

ingredients.form: boiled with decoction till freed from water

formulations.preparation_method: All drugs decocted in water; milk boiled with decoction until freed from water; added with pastes of vitaliser drugs, ghee, honey, rock salt; well-cooled before use
formulations.anupana: Boiled shali rice with meat soup of wild animals or milk after a light bath

formulations.name: Draksha Pitta-alleviating Milk Basti
formulations.preparation_method: Milk boiled with draksha, rddhi, kashmarya, madhuka, usira, sariva, candana, sitapakya; added with paste of shravani etc. and honey, ghee, madhuyasti taila, juice of vidari, sugarcane and jaggery
indications: burning sensation of sides and head

formulations.name: Koshatha-Aragvadha Kaphaja Basti
formulations.preparation_method: Decoction of herbs in water, 800 ml taken, added with pastes, oils and alkalis

formulations.name: Rasna Guduchi Tridosha Basti
formulations.preparation_method: Decoction of all drugs mixed with decoction of madanaphala and cow's urine, paste of drugs added along with salt, ghee, honey and oil

formulations.name: Punarnava Eranda Milk Basti (Tridosha)
formulations.preparation_method: Boiled in milk and water 5.12 litres till only milk remains. Strained through white cloth. Added with pastes and fats when neither too hot nor too cold
indications: disorders caused by three or two doshas jointly

formulations.name: Dagamula Vatika Anuvasana Basti
formulations.preparation_method: Boil all herbs in water 40.96 litres reduced to 10.24 litres. Oil mixed with equal quantity of milk and paste of vitaliser drugs should be prepared

formulations.name: Satahva Bilva Oil (Vatika Anuvasana)
formulations.preparation_method: Oil cooked with satahva, barley, bilva and sour substances

formulations.name: Rock Salt Ghee Anuvasana
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee heated with rock salt on fire

formulations.name: Jivanti Madana Taila (Vata-Pitta Anuvasana)
formulations.preparation_method: Oil and ghee mixed, cooked with paste of all drugs and four times milk
indications: eliminates defects of urine, semen and menses

formulations.name: Chandanadi Ghrita (Pitta-alleviating Anuvasana)
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee mixed with one-fourth oil, cooked with paste of candanadi drugs as available and four times milk

formulations.name: Rock Salt Madana Kapha-alleviating Taila

ingredients.herb_name: Castor oil or other kapha-alleviating oil

formulations.preparation_method: All drugs pounded and castor oil (or kapha-alleviating oil) cooked with this mixture

formulations.name: Vidanga Eranda Haridra Taila (Tridosha Taila)
formulations.type: Anuvasana Basti / External application / Internal intake
formulations.preparation_method: Oil cooked with decoction of listed herbs and paste of listed herbs
indications: firmness to feet, shanks, thighs, back, shoulder and waist
virility to sterile women and men

formulations.name: Matrabasti

ingredients.quantity: equal to lowest dose of Anuvasana Basti

formulations.preparation_method: Unctuous substance in lowest measured dose administered as enema
formulations.dosage: Equal to lowest dose of unctuous enema (Anuvasana)

formulations.name: Prsniparni Salaparni Milk Basti (Excessive application burns)
formulations.preparation_method: All herbs pounded and dissolved in milk, rice water, cold extract of draksha, cold earthen water and madhuka, added with ghee
indications: burning sensation caused by excessive application of enema

formulations.name: Pippali Water Digestive Drink (Post-Enema)
formulations.preparation_method: Drugs boiled in water and sauvarcala salt added

formulations.name: Panchatikta Basti
formulations.preparation_method: Decoction of five bitters combined 320 ml, ghee 80 gm added with paste of mustard

formulations.name: Vidanga Triphala Anthelmintic Basti
formulations.preparation_method: All herbs churned, added with paste of vidanga and pippali

formulations.name: Milk Honey Oil Ghee Simple Basti
formulations.preparation_method: Milk 160 ml, honey, oil and ghee mixed 240 gm churned together with a churning stick

formulations.name: Panchamula Oil Vata Basti (Prasrta)
formulations.preparation_method: Panchamula decoction combined with oil, honey and ghee

formulations.name: Rock Salt Hapusa Semen-promoting Basti
formulations.preparation_method: Combined as non-unctuous enema

formulations.name: Payasya Sugarcane Semen Basti (Prasrta)
formulations.preparation_method: Juices combined with honey and ghee, added with paste of pippali

formulations.name: Goksura Pashanabheda Dysuria Basti
formulations.preparation_method: Decoctions, oil and surasava combined 400 ml; added with paste of madhuyasti, kaunti, magadhika and sita; total 720 gm; used warm with salt
formulations.dosage: Total 720 gm, used warm with salt

formulations.name: Anjana Chandana Churned Drink (Atisara - excessive purgation)
formulations.preparation_method: Churned drink prepared with anjana, candana, usira, marrow, blood, sharkara, water and powder of parched paddy

formulations.name: Musta Ativisa Devadaru Digestive Decoction
formulations.preparation_method: Decoction of all drugs

formulations.name: Udumbara Bark Ghrita (Diarrhoea)
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee cooked with double quantity of milk and paste of all drugs
indications: all types of diarrhoea according to strength

formulations.name: Marica Sigru Head Evacuation Powder
formulations.preparation_method: Fine powder of all drugs used as head-evacuation (head nasya)
indications: channels obstructed by kapha and vata

formulations.name: Tumburu Haritaki Heart Formula
formulations.preparation_method: Powders combined and taken with water boiled with barley

formulations.name: Hingu Pomegranate Vata-Kapha Formula
formulations.preparation_method: Combined and taken together

formulations.name: Sauvarcala Haritaki Trikatu Ghrita (Apatantraka)
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee cooked with sauvarcala, haritaki and trikatu
indications: when drastic evacuative enema is not suitable
contraindications: not suitable for patient wholly when having apatantraka

formulations.name: Hingu Amlavetasa Digestive Drink (Hridaya)
formulations.preparation_method: Powdered asafoetida added with powder of one of the salts, taken with juice of matulunga or palatable sour liquid
formulations.anupana: Juice of matulunga (citron) or palatable sour liquid

formulations.name: Laghu Panchamula Decoction with Sugar (Hridaya)
formulations.preparation_method: Decoction of laghu panchamula added with sugar as drink; gruel also cooked with same decoction

formulations.name: Guduchi Bala Mahashveta Unctuous Substance (Shira Kampa)
formulations.preparation_method: Uncting substance processed with gudaci, bala, mahashveta and ashvagandha
indications: unction and sudation and saturating snuffing

formulations.name: Shatavari Goksura Tailam (Mutravaha disorders)
formulations.preparation_method: Oil processed with four times decoction of roots and milk, along with paste of all drugs; used as urethral douche (uttarabasti) or non-unctuous enema in evacuated, uncted and fomented patient
formulations.dosage: 20 gm or so according to age
